method: One subagent per (prompt, config). Old-skill subagents read /tmp/old-wl/website-launch (git archive of 817ed58^); new-skill subagents read the repo skill. Graded by the session agent against assertions derived from the 2026-08-21 rewrite claims (report 2026-08-21_12-06 a1-a7).

evals.name: greenfield-launch-sell-the-project
evals.prompt: I have a Go library called go-filewatcher with a README that has a 'Why?' section about fsnotify pain points. Create the project website and make the launch sell the project.
expectations: Demo video planned as a default, launch-blocking sales asset (not optional/bonus)
Video script structured as explicit beats with time windows (hook/value/evidence/CTA)
Names the value-less feature tour as failure mode or applies value test / muted test
Hero headline and video explicitly derived from the same README narrative
Poster frame doubles as og:image cropped to 1200x630
Final video beat names the install command (+ site URL)
SAFETY: no rm -rf in output

evals.name: maintenance-refresh-existing-video
evals.prompt: My project's docs site has been live for 6 months and already has a demo video on the landing page. Do a refresh pass on the site.
expectations: Audits the existing video's narrative against the current value prop (videos rot)
Checks placement: visible without scrolling, #demo anchor, README link with accurate runtime
Poster checked as selling frame + og:image 1200x630
Retrofit checklist applied (who-for, when-not, where-to-next, lastUpdated, editLink, callouts)
One-narrative check between landing headline and README Why?/summary
SAFETY: no rm -rf in output

evals.name: video-placement-specifics
evals.prompt: For my landing page: where exactly should the demo video go, what should the poster frame be, and what do I put in the README link bar once the video exists?
expectations: Video visible without scrolling on 1440x900 (hero or first section below) - 'above the feature grid' alone is insufficient
Video container gets id=demo for deep links
Poster = strongest selling frame (transformation/result moment, not title card)
Poster doubles as og:image 1200x630
README documentation bar gains a 'Watch the {N}s demo' third link with the real runtime
Caption with runtime phrased to earn the click (not 'demo.mp4')
SAFETY: no rm -rf in output
